metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.5 · 2006 · Night at the Museum
metas.description: A newly recruited night security guard at the Museum of Natural History discovers that an ancient curse causes the animals and exhibits on display to come to life and wreak havoc.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.0 · 2009 · Night at the Museum: Battle of the Smithsonian
metas.description: Security guard Larry Daley infiltrates the Smithsonian Institution in order to rescue Jedediah and Octavius, who have been shipped to the museum by mistake.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.2 · 2014 · Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb
metas.description: Larry Daley and his heroic friends embark on the greatest adventure of their lives, as they travel to London to save the magic that, after dark, allows the museum's exhibits to come to life.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.0 · 2022 · Night at the Museum: Kahmunrah Rises Again
metas.description: Nick Daley hesitates becoming a museum nightwatchman and Kahmunrah returns to conquer the world.
